objective: Independently verify the approved G3-EXTENSION outage-delivery and internal handler-fault behavior against false success, replay, and diagnostic activation leakage.
requirements: A real host request attempted during outage is unavailable/unknown, never provider-processed, and never auto-replayed after same-process reconnect; a distinct fresh request succeeds once.

Internal handler fault activates only when both the opt-in environment and explicit diagnostic frame are present, occurs before public API enqueue, produces no success ACK/provider/agent_start, and the same message remains unknown_no_replay across reconnect.
Normal operation and malformed frames do not accidentally activate the fault path; original TUI/composer and role/session/generation identity remain valid.
Tests must contain a discriminating negative mutation/control that would fail if an outage/fault message were ACKed, provider-processed, or replayed.
constraints: Do not modify product code or existing tests/probes.
Use bounded runtime and cleanup; do not rely only on source-string assertions.
Do not modify workflow/docs/graphify or commit/reset/clean/stash.
